| File | Package | Licence | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `react-18.3.1.production.min.js`, `react-dom-18.3.1.production.min.js` | react, react-dom 18.3.1 | MIT | `/security/` |
| `reactflow-11.11.4.umd.js` | reactflow 11.11.4 | MIT | `/security/` |
| `lenis-1.3.26.min.js` | lenis 1.3.26 (dist/lenis.min.js) | MIT | the home page: smooth scrolling |

The source-map comments are removed, since the maps are not served.
